number-and-operation.title: Read the signs
number-and-operation.explanation: A sign attached to a number tells you whether it is positive or negative. The operation between numbers tells you what to do.
number-and-operation.guidance: Separate the operation from the sign of the next number.
examples: In 5 − (−3), the operation is subtraction and the next number is negative three.

subtract-negative.title: Rewrite subtraction
subtract-negative.explanation: Subtracting a number is the same as adding its opposite.
subtract-negative.guidance: Change the subtraction to addition and change the sign of the number being subtracted.

inverse-check.title: Check by undoing
inverse-check.explanation: You can undo an addition with subtraction, or a subtraction with addition.
inverse-check.guidance: Start with your answer and undo the operation to recover the starting number.
